brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess safety and tolerablility of AZD1656 after multiple repeated oral doses in patients with type 2 diabetes on top of metformin.
brief_title: To Evaluate Safety and Tolerability After Multiple Oral Doses of AZD1656 in Type 2 Diabetes Patients on Top of Metformin

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female (with non child-bearing potential)
* Diagnosed diabetes Mellitus patients treated with metformin alone or one other anti-diabetic drugs. Stable blood sugar control indicated by no changed treatment within 3 months prior to study start.t
* HbA1c \<11 % at screening (HbA1c value according to international DCCT standard)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Clinically significant illness or clinically relevant trauma, as judged by the investigator, within two weeks before the first administration of the IP
* History of ischemic heart disease, stroke, transitorisk ischemic attack or symptomatic peripheral vascular disease
* Clinically significant abnormalities in clinical chemistry, hematology, or urinalysis results.

official_title: A Randomized, Single-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Phase I Study to Assess the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics After Multiple Ascending Oral Doses of AZD1656 in Subjects With T2DM Treated With Metformin

primary_outcomes.measure: Safety variables (AE, BP, pulse, plasma glucose, laboratory variables, weight and ECG)
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Blood samples taken repeatedly during 24 hours on study day sessions
